result.topic_en: Pencil calculations with complex logarithmic expressions for coordinates in terms of a variable η (as for a catenoid/helicoid-type minimal surface), together with a differential condition and the parametric equations of a straight line.
result.transcription:
[-$x = i\log\eta$-]
[-$\frac{\eta}{1+\eta\eta'}$-] [?]
$dx = \frac{a}{\alpha} i \log\eta$ \quad $x = \frac{a}{\alpha} i\,(\log\eta - \log\eta')$
$ds = \frac{a}{\alpha} i\left(d\eta + \frac{d\eta'}{\eta\eta'}\right)$ \quad $s = \frac{a}{\alpha} i\left(\eta - \frac{1}{\eta'}\right)$
$ds' = -\frac{a}{\alpha} i\left(d\eta' + \frac{d\eta}{\eta\eta}\right)$ \quad $s' = \frac{a}{\alpha} i\left(\frac{1}{\eta} - \eta'\right)$

$x\,d\xi + y\,dy + z\,dz$

$\alpha\,dx + \beta\,dy + \gamma\,dz = 0$
$d\xi = \gamma\,dy - \beta\,dz$

$x = \alpha' t + a$ \quad $\alpha'' dt$
$y = \beta' t + b$ \quad $\beta'' dt$
$z = \gamma' t + c$ \quad $\gamma'' dt$

methods.what: Coordinate x expressed as a difference of logarithms of the complex variable η and its conjugate η'
Complex coordinates s, s' expressed rationally in η, η' and their differentials
Differential of the complex coordinate s
Linear differential condition (orthogonality to direction α,β,γ) and associated differential dξ
Parametric equations of a straight line
